title: color-interpolation
why: Standard SVG/CSS property shipping in all four engines, but missing from mdn-data, so VS Code reports it as an unknown property.

upstream.mdn-data: branch css/color-interpolation: adds the property to css/properties.json (needs PR to mdn/data)
upstream.vscode-custom-data: picks it up after an mdn-data release + dependency bump; description lookup needs the fix-mdn-doc-paths change

properties.name: color-interpolation
properties.description: Specifies the color space used for gradient interpolation, color animation and alpha compositing in SVG.

values.auto: The browser may interpolate in either the sRGB or the linearRGB color space.
values.sRGB: Interpolate in the sRGB color space. This is the initial value.
values.linearRGB: Interpolate in the linearized RGB color space.
